_readme: Hand-reviewed meaning of each PENDING Title 17 text amendment (WS2 PR3). The Clerk is authoritative for what is pending and its status; this file is authoritative for which Profile rule or fact a pending proposal COULD change. Keyed by lifecycle id (the original O-number); reviewed_record is the exact record whose text was read, and a different current record (a new substitute) is unreviewed until re-read. basis 'ordinance' = the Legislation PDF was read (never an Economic Disclosure Statement); only that basis may carry impacts. basis 'title' = reviewed from the title alone: it can only say 'no Profile fact', never a relevance. impacts[]: sections = the Title 17 sections the proposal edits; fact_ids = the Profile facts it could change (backend/provenance.py FACTS, plus note.* for coverage notes); applies_when = deterministic conditions on this parcel (zone_patterns: regexes searched in the upper-case zone class; overlays_any / overlays_none: overlay layer types; facts_all: Profile facts that must be shown; address_ranges: street segments matched by address); reach 'untested' = the parcel cannot be tested for the proposal's geographic or building-level condition, so the Profile says so rather than claim reach. Nothing here changes a current-law answer. Written by reading in a Claude Code session; no model call in the product.
